name: 2762-sharedprefix-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM (LLaMA-1, 6.7B) dense decoder, torch_dtype float16, context window 2048, ~13.5 GB of weights. Ungated. A BASE checkpoint with no chat template, which is why scenario.json declares `request_format: plain`.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 10% and cooldown 10% both pinned to `mode: requests`, bounded at 200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, one turn per request: a 512-token opening that is identical across the whole run, then 256 tokens distinct per request, then 128 output tokens with `ignore_eos`. Sampling is temperature 0.0, n=1, no penalties, no logprobs, no beam search.
purpose: A 7B document assistant serving 16 concurrent users short answers over a shared 512-token boilerplate preamble on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit baee28c46c242b72f90d6b1211ab9d7872ab05d3 -- `git describe --tags` reads
# v0.3.3-2-gbaee28c46c242 (March 2024). No published wheel IS this engine, so it is named by
# `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# ERA WARNING. `AsyncEngineArgs` at this commit accepts a fixed set of fields and an unknown key
# is a TypeError at engine construction. Do NOT add a key from a later vLLM.
#
# NOTHING HERE IS TUNED: every line is either the checkpoint's own window or this engine's own
# default written out against drift.

model: huggyllama/llama-7b
dtype: half
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

block-size: 16
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
max-paddings: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
swap-space: 4
enforce-eager: false
seed: 0
